verdict.rationale: Logseq is a local-first desktop/mobile knowledge base app with a GUI, HTTP API for plugin access, and a plugin marketplace, but there is no evidence of a headless mode, CLI invocation, or CI-friendly automation interface. The HTTP API server requires the app running with a UI enabled and no docs describe headless/CI usage; probes for API specs (openapi.json, llms.txt) also returned 404. Missing for 10: any documented headless/CLI mode, CI pipeline examples, or automation-focused API without the GUI running.
